S.sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN (typeof(version)='integer' AND version BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __valid,
  CASE WHEN (typeof(version)='integer' AND version BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991) THEN version ELSE NULL END AS version
FROM schema_migrations
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY version
LIMIT 18;
